name: pam_timestamp_check
description: Check credential timestamp validity (companion to pam_timestamp)
detailed_description: Authentication module that validates previously cached credential timestamps created by pam_timestamp. Used in conjunction with pam_timestamp to determine if re-authentication is required. Often used by sudo for credential reuse checking.
notes:
Companion module to pam_timestamp; validates cached credentials. Typically used with sudo.
